arxiv-1808-06911.title: Heavy-traffic Delay Optimality in Pull-based Load Balancing Systems: Necessary and Sufficient Conditions
arxiv-1808-06911.creator: Xingyu Zhou, Jian Tan, Ness Shroff
arxiv-1808-06911.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider a load balancing system under a general pull-based policy. In particular, each arrival is randomly dispatched to one of the servers whose queue lengths are below a threshold, if there are any; otherwise, this arrival is randomly dispatched to one of the entire set of servers.

arxiv-2005-03963.title: Construction of Minimum Spanning Trees from Financial Returns using Rank Correlation
arxiv-2005-03963.creator: Tristan Millington, Mahesan Niranjan
arxiv-2005-03963.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Tristan Millington, Mahesan Niranjan. The construction of minimum spanning trees (MSTs) from correlation matrices is an often used method to study relationships in the financial markets. However most of the work on this topic tends to use the Pearson correlation coefficient, which relies on the assumption of normality and can be brittle to the presence of outliers, neither of which is ideal for the study of financial returns.

arxiv-2107-02358.title: Impact of On-Chip Interconnect on In-Memory Acceleration of Deep Neural Networks Journal: JETC Volume: 1 1 1 1 Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.1145/3460233 Thanks: *Authors have equal contributions. CCS: Hardware Emerging architectures CCS: Computing methodologies Machine learning CCS: Computing methodologies
arxiv-2107-02358.creator: Gokul Krishnan*, Sumit K. Mandal*, Chaitali Chakrabarti, Jae-sun Seo, Umit Y. Ogras, Yu Cao
arxiv-2107-02358.description: Abstract . With the widespread use of Deep Neural Networks (DNNs), machine learning algorithms have evolved in two diverse directions – one with ever-increasing connection density for better accuracy and the other with more compact sizing for energy efficiency. The increase in connection density increases on-chip data movement, which makes efficient on-chip communication a critical function of the DNN accelerator.

arxiv-2202-10922.title: Simulation of crack propagation through voxel-based, heterogeneous structures based on eigenerosion and finite cells
arxiv-2202-10922.creator: Dennis Wingender
arxiv-2202-10922.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Dennis Wingender. Keywords: ductile crack propagation, eigenerosion, Finite Cell Method, hanging nodes, heterogeneities 1 Introduction In many mechanical engineering applications, the analysis of cracks propagating through heterogeneous structures is subject to investigation. One prominent example is wear of hardened tool materials, which undergo cyclic loading leading to crack propagation on the microscopic level resulting in wear in form of surface spalling and even structural failure.

arxiv-2210-02137.title: Internet Service Providers’ and Individuals’ Attitudes, Barriers, and Incentives to Secure IoT
arxiv-2210-02137.creator: Nissy Sombatruang 1 and Tristan Caulfield 2 and Ingolf Becker 2 and Akira Fujita 1 and Takahiro Kasama 1 and Koji Nakao 1 and Daisuke Inoue 1 and 1 National Institute of Information and Communications Technology 2 University College London
arxiv-2210-02137.description: Abstract Internet Service Providers (ISPs) and individual users of Internet of Things (IoT) play a vital role in securing IoT. However, encouraging them to do so is hard. Our study investigates ISPs’ and individuals’ attitudes towards the security of IoT, the obstacles they face, and their incentives to keep IoT secure, drawing evidence from Japan.

arxiv-2309-17284.title: Differentially Private Computation of Basic Reproduction Numbers in Networked Epidemic Models
arxiv-2309-17284.creator: Bo Chen, Baike She, Calvin Hawkins, Alex Benvenuti, Brandon Fallin, Philip E. Paré, Matthew Hale
arxiv-2309-17284.description: Abstract The basic reproduction number of a networked epidemic model, denoted R 0 R_{0} , can be computed from a network’s topology to quantify epidemic spread. However, disclosure of R 0 R_{0} risks revealing sensitive information about the underlying network, such as an individual’s relationships within a social network.

arxiv-2406-17572.title: Ranking nodes in bipartite systems with a non-linear iterative map
arxiv-2406-17572.creator: Andrea Mazzolini, Michele Caselle, Matteo Osella
arxiv-2406-17572.description: Abstract Ranking nodes in networks according to a defined measure of importance is an extensively studied task, with applications in ecology, economic trade networks, and social networks. This paper introduces a method based on a non-linear iterative map to evaluate node relevance in bipartite networks.

europmc-pmc5447093.description: Cardiac parasympathetic activity may be non-invasively investigated using heart rate variability (HRV), although HRV is not widely accepted to reflect sympathetic activity. Instead, cardiac sympathetic activity may be investigated using systolic time intervals (STI), such as the

pmc-10492270.title: Neoadjuvant chemotherapy weakens the prognostic value of the pathological tumor burden score for colorectal cancer liver metastases
pmc-10492270.creator: Leen Liao, Hui Sun, Jiahua He, Yujun Liu, Zhizhong Pan, Xiaojun Wu, Wenhua Fan, Jianhong Peng, Cong Li
pmc-10492270.description: BackgroundThe pathological tumor burden score (TBS) has been proven to be a better risk stratification tool for liver metastasis of colorectal cancer than the traditional clinical risk score (CRS). The aim of this study was to evaluate the prognostic value of the pathological tumor burden score in patients with or without neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC).

pmc-10691004.title: Network pharmacology-based strategy to investigate the bioactive ingredients and molecular mechanism of Evodia rutaecarpa in colorectal cancer
pmc-10691004.creator: Yongqu Lu, Kangdi Dong, Meng Yang, Jun Liu
pmc-10691004.description: BackgroundEvodia rutaecarpa, a traditional herbal drug, is widely used as an analgesic and antiemetic. Many studies have confirmed that Evodia rutaecarpa has an anticancer effect. Here, our study explored the bioactive ingredients in Evodia rutaecarpa acting on colorectal cancer (CRC) by utilizing network pharmacology.MethodsWe clarified the effective ingredients and corresponding targets of Evodia rutaecarpa.

pmc-11299197.title: Unexpected diagnosis of rare mesenteric Castleman disease: A case report and literature review
pmc-11299197.creator: Jianan Ji, Mingjie Tang, Hua Liu
pmc-11299197.description: In this report, we present an Asian male patient who was 30 years old and admitted to the hospital due to pancreatitis. While undergoing a CT scan, an isolated mass was unexpectedly discovered in the patient’s abdomen. The patient’s abdominal pain, which was caused by pancreatitis, had resolved before he underwent surgical resection to remove the mass.

pmc-11342091.title: A case of carcinoid syndrome after CT guided lung biopsy of a neuroendocrine tumor
pmc-11342091.creator: Benjamin Perrin Hee, Emmanuel Ihionkhan, Rajiv Biswal
pmc-11342091.description: Carcinoid tumors of the lung are an uncommon malignancy that can rarely lead to carcinoid syndrome. Carcinoid tumors represent less than 1% of all lung cancers. This case describes a rare presentation in which a previously asymptomatic woman began to experience tachycardia, shortness of breath, and anxiety after biopsy of a pulmonary carcinoid tumor.

pmc-11435254.title: Analysis of Compliance with Proper Nutrition Principles in Patients with a History of Myocardial Infarction
pmc-11435254.creator: Patrycja Krężel, Ewa Kurek, Anna Jurczak, Izabela Napieracz-Trzosek, Dorota Iłgowska, Katarzyna Młyńska, Sylwia Wieder-Huszla
pmc-11435254.description: Adherence to dietary recommendations and the implementation of appropriate dietary habits after myocardial infarction (MI) can significantly improve health and reduce mortality from cardiac causes. The aim of this study was to analyse the adherence of patients with a history of MI to a healthy diet, which is one of the primary methods of cardiovascular disease (CVD) prevention.

pmc-12359940.title: Prediction premenstrual syndrome (PMS) with anxiety, and depression in female students
pmc-12359940.creator: Huansheng Li, Mandana Sarokhani, Mohammad Hossein Sahami Gilan, Reza valizade, Kourosh Sayehmiri
pmc-12359940.description: BackgroundPremenstrual syndrome (PMS) is a prevalent and multifaceted disorder affecting women of childbearing age, characterized by emotional, physical, and behavioral symptoms. The psychological dimensions, particularly anxiety and depression, exacerbate the burden of PMS. This research aimed to find predictive factors of PMS using ordinal logistic regression models (OLR).

pmc-12382935.title: Music as Fluidum: A Rheological Approach to the Materiality of Sound as Movement Through Time
pmc-12382935.creator: Mark Reybrouck, Pier Luigi Sacco
pmc-12382935.description: Music is an elusive phenomenon with sounds that disappear while sounding. This challenges the description of the music and its processing by the listener or performer. A possible answer to this problem lies in the definition of music as flowing sound energy that continuously modifies its substance and shape.

pmc-12535148.title: Spontaneous Idiopathic Non-venereal Cavernosal Abscess: A Rare Case Report and Review of Literature
pmc-12535148.creator: Prajeeth Reddy, Punith Jain R, Hariharasudhan Sekar, Velmurugan Palaniyandi, Sriram Krishnamoorthy
pmc-12535148.description: Penile abscesses are uncommon in urology and usually arise from trauma, intracavernous injections, systemic infections, and sexually transmitted infections (STIs). However, spontaneous cases with no definitive causes are sporadic. Here, we describe an unusual presentation in a 55-year-old man with no history of trauma, diabetes, immunosuppression, or recent sexual activity.

pmc-12619587.title: Making Multidisciplinary Team-Based Care (MTBC) a Success in Primary Care: A Scoping Review Care: A Scoping Review
pmc-12619587.creator: Zhanming Liang, Jasmine Montgomery, Cate Dingelstad, Alison Koschel, Michelle Redford
pmc-12619587.description: Patient-centred care is the foundation for safe and high-quality care that enhances patient health outcomes, with multidisciplinary team-based care (MTBC) being a key enabling factor. MTBC is an integrated approach in care provision involving health professionals with different skillsets working in collaboration.

pmc-12737131.title: Molecular Networking Reveals Antioxidant Properties and Phenolic Profiles of Four Rosaceae Seeds
pmc-12737131.creator: Mi Jeong Lim, Jinyoung Park, Min Sung Lee, Seong Yeon Choi, Heejung Yang, Taewan Kim, Chae Sun Na, Jorge Luis Chávez-Servín, Aarón Kuri-García
pmc-12737131.description: For centuries, four Rosaceae species—Malus sieboldii, Sorbus commixta, Duchesnea indica, and Prunus sargentii—have been prized for their pharmacological properties. In this study, solvent extracts from the seeds of these species were prepared, and their total polyphenol and flavonoid contents were measured.

pmc-12999238.title: Meta-Analysis of Anxiety Symptoms and Influencing Factors Among Chinese College Students
pmc-12999238.creator: Jiami Wu, Jiayi Gu, Dadong Gu
pmc-12999238.description: Objective To explore the influencing factors on anxiety symptoms among Chinese college students and provide a reference for the prevention and treatment of mental disorders in this population. Methods The PubMed, Embase, CNKI, Wanfang Data, and VIP databases were searched electronically for published studies on anxiety symptoms among Chinese college students. A meta-analysis was conducted using RevMan 5.

pmc-13062357.title: Failure of a Modular Femoral Revision Stem in Hip Arthroplasty: A Rare Complication and Literature Review
pmc-13062357.creator: Osama Aldowekat, Jihad Al-Ajlouni, Taghleb Al-Awad, Malak Smida, Zaid Ta’ani
pmc-13062357.description: Introduction:Zimmer modular revision (ZMR)® femoral stems are widely utilized in revision total hip arthroplasty (rTHA) due to their intraoperative customization that offers surgical flexibility in reconstructing complex hip joints. However, despite these advantages, the modular junction is prone to localized stress concentration, which may transfer cantilever loads distally.

pmc-13279052.title: Student and Graduate Perceptions of Their Development of the Core Attitudes From the British Pharmacological Society's Undergraduate Pharmacology Curriculum
pmc-13279052.creator: Sophie G. Reed, Aidan Seeley, Nicola Williams, John Broad

pmc-13656594.title: Prevalence and associated factors of sleep bruxism in Turkish schoolchildren with mixed dentition: a cross-sectional study
pmc-13656594.creator: Gülçin Bulut, Gülser Kılınç, Saime Esin Güney, Bengisu Çağan
pmc-13656594.description: BackgroundFactors associated with sleep bruxism (SB) in children with mixed dentition remain incompletely understood. This study examined the relationship between sleep bruxism and sleep behaviors, oral habits, temporomandibular disorders (TMD), and health status in Turkish schoolchildren during the mixed dentition stage.MethodsIn this cross-sectional study, a representative sample of 452 schoolchildren was assessed.
